sentences.text: 1 Crl.M.C.No.3694 of 2025  2  ORDER Dated this the 11th day of April, 2025 Petitioner is the 1st accused in Crime No.470 of 2013 registered at the Eloor Police Station for offences punishable under Sections 406 and 420 of IPC.

Petitioner's failure to appear in court after taking of cognizance resulted in inclusion of the case in the long pending register, numbered as L.P No.121 of 2024 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kalamassery and issuance of non-bailable warrant against the petitioner.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court, Kalamassery
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This Crl.M.C is filed seeking an opportunity to surrender and for a direction to consider petitioner's bail application on the day of surrender itself.
2. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that his client was never served with summons and the 2nd accused faced trial and was acquitted.
3. I heard the learned Public Prosecutor also.

4. Considering the willingness expressed, the limited relief sought and the submission that the 2 nd accused is acquitted, the Crl.M.C is disposed of as under:
i) The petitioner shall surrender and move application for bail before the jurisdictional court within three weeks.
ii) If petitioner surrenders within the time granted, learned Magistrate shall pass orders on the application for bail on the day of surrender itself.
2025:KER:32348 iii) Execution of the non-bailable warrant pending against the petitioner shall be kept in abeyance for three weeks..
